title: The Last Landing
description: With Isolde Vane answered, the east stair door is only a door. The Stair-Taper was cut for this stair, a notch to every landing, and the count goes past one now.

stages.text: Up the east stair with the Stair-Taper lit from the ember, counting the landings, while the Provost counts the hand up from the foot.

On the seventh landing, under the lantern room, the count finished and the rest came back: the High Keeper with the last coal, a novice who asked to carry it, a hood pinned so nobody would see whose face went down the stair. The ember is made of the Wakebearer. The Provost is still counting at the foot.
